shabad.source_english: Codes of Conduct and Other Panthic Sources

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਾਜ ਕਰੇਗਾ ਖਾਲਸਾ ਆਕੀ ਰਹੇ ਨ ਕੋਇ
verses.translit_en: raaj karegaa khaalasaa aakee rahe na koi

en.bdb: The Khalsa will rule and the rebels will be eliminated,

verses.gurmukhi: ਖ਼ੁਆਰ ਹੋਏ ਸਭ ਮਿਲਹਿੰ ਗੇ ਬਚੇ ਸ਼ਰਨ ਜੋ ਹੋਇ। (੬੨)
verses.translit_en: khhuaar hoe sabh milahi(n) ge bache sharan jo hoi| (62)

en.bdb: All will be obliged to join and only those who surrender will survive.(62)
